response.overview: # Maaf Tak Indah (Sorry, Not Beautiful)  Syazan and Raimie's happy marriage suddenly changes when Syazan is confirmed to be pregnant. They only then realize that their desires are different. Syazan does not want children but Raimie desperately wants one. Syazan's actions cause them to almost lose the child she is carrying, and when she begins to realize, it is already too late. She loses everything. Their happiness is destroyed in an instant. Raimie leaves taking their child and enters into a relationship with Zila. After five years, they are reunited due to work matters and Syazan pleads to be allowed to meet with Adam. Raimie allows Syazan to meet Adam on the condition that Syazan sleeps with him. For the sake of a mother's love, Syazan agrees to her ex-husband's foolish condition, but Raimie, who actually still loves Syazan, has no intention of treating his ex-wife badly.
response.title: Maaf Tak Indah
